title: USDJPY Complementary Strategy Opportunity Study — Opportunity Atlas v1
purpose: Identify independent return sources that B02 and F05 do not structurally cover. This study does not improve, filter, stop, route, or retune B02/F05.

2024_m15.authority: accepted UTC Bid/Ask bars derived from durable public Bid/Ask ticks; not Rakuten quote history

execution_contract.signal_timing: completed bar only; entry at next available M15 Bid open
execution_contract.exit_timing: fixed family-specific holding horizon; no stop, target, trailing rule, or optimized exit
execution_contract.candidate_overlap_policy: one active position per variant; family aggregate uses deterministic first-signal priority and one active position per family
execution_contract.baseline_comparison: entry-date daily realized P/L; additive unconstrained portfolio estimate without margin or capital suppression

interpretation_boundary: All opportunity and portfolio values are historical research estimates. No family, threshold, rule, EA, or production deployment is authorized by this atlas.
